name: Bite the Bullet
entriesHtml: As a Bonus Action|XPHB, you can expend one Risk|Gunslinger|ValdaGunslinger|2|ValdaGunslinger|Risk Die to gain Temporary Hit Points|XPHB equal to the number rolled on the die plus your Gunslinger level.
description: As a Bonus Action|XPHB, you can expend one Risk|Gunslinger|ValdaGunslinger|2|ValdaGunslinger|Risk Die to gain Temporary Hit Points|XPHB equal to the number rolled on the die plus your Gunslinger level.

name: Blindfire
entriesHtml: You can take a Bonus Action|XPHB and expend one Risk|Gunslinger|ValdaGunslinger|2|ValdaGunslinger|Risk Die to gain Blindsight with a range of 30 feet until the end of the current turn.
description: You can take a Bonus Action|XPHB and expend one Risk|Gunslinger|ValdaGunslinger|2|ValdaGunslinger|Risk Die to gain Blindsight with a range of 30 feet until the end of the current turn.

name: Dodge Roll
entriesHtml: You can expend one Risk|Gunslinger|ValdaGunslinger|2|ValdaGunslinger|Risk Die as a Bonus Action|XPHB to move up to 15 feet and reload any Ranged weapon you are holding. This movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attack and is unaffected by Difficult Terrain|XPHB.
description: You can expend one Risk|Gunslinger|ValdaGunslinger|2|ValdaGunslinger|Risk Die as a Bonus Action|XPHB to move up to 15 feet and reload any Ranged weapon you are holding. This movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attack and is unaffected by Difficult Terrain|XPHB.

name: Grazing Shot
entriesHtml: When you miss with a ranged attack roll using a weapon, you can expend one Risk|Gunslinger|ValdaGunslinger|2|ValdaGunslinger|Risk Die (no action required) to deal damage to that creature equal to a roll of the die plus your Dexterity modifier (minimum of 1). This damage is the same type dealt by the weapon, and the damage can be increased only by increasing the ability modifier. You can only use this maneuver once per turn.

This damage is the same type dealt by the weapon, and the damage can be increased only by increasing the ability modifier. You can only use this maneuver once per turn.

name: Maverick Spirit
entriesHtml: When you fail an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma ability check or saving throw, you can expend one Risk|Gunslinger|ValdaGunslinger|2|ValdaGunslinger|Risk Die to add it to the roll, potentially turning it into a success. You can only use this maneuver once per turn.
description: When you fail an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma ability check or saving throw, you can expend one Risk|Gunslinger|ValdaGunslinger|2|ValdaGunslinger|Risk Die to add it to the roll, potentially turning it into a success. You can only use this maneuver once per turn.

name: Skin of Your Teeth
entriesHtml: When a creature you can see hits you with an attack roll, you can take a Reaction|XPHB and expend one Risk|Gunslinger|ValdaGunslinger|2|ValdaGunslinger|Risk Die to dodge out of harm's way. Roll the die and add the number rolled to your AC against this attack, potentially causing it to miss.
